svg.aria-label: Four stored resolution levels covering the same extent, with the zoom selecting one
svg.text: for data larger than memory, or a reduction too slow to repeat
level 3 is the coarsest level with
at least one sample per pixel
level 0 is the coarsest level with
at least one sample per pixel
Every level covers the whole recording, and only the resolution differs. The finest is dashed because it is referenced, not written.
